Preterm birth complications (B) were the leading cause of death in children under five in 2017, at roughly 0.9 to 1 million deaths, ahead of pneumonia and diarrheal disease. The shared team note also lists preterm birth as one of the two possible answers, which is consistent with this. I'm working from memory of the UN IGME and WHO figures, not a fresh source check.
